Row.Text: We, writers, painters, sculptors, architects and passionate devotees of the hitherto untouched beauty, protest with all our strength, with all our indignation in the name of slighted taste, against the erection of this useless and monstrous Eiffel Tower. To bring our arguments home, imagine for a moment a giddy, ridiculous tower dominating the landscape like a gigantic black smokestack, crushing under its barbaric bulk all of our humiliated monuments which will disappear in this ghastly dream.
We can't take it down! We're using it as a radio tower!
[ICON_BULLET][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Lose {2_InstantYield}.[ENDCOLOR][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]A Broadcast Tower is built in the city.[ENDCOLOR]
[ICON_BULLET][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]The Eiffel Tower is dismantled[ENDCOLOR][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Receive 3 free Great Artists[ENDCOLOR]
In response to criticism, the Eiffel Tower has been torn down. Local artists celebrate its removal!
